item.title: She Hid Her Parents for 4 YEARS | Virginia McCullough | Bodycam
item.description: Virginia McCullough hid a horrifying secret inside her Essex home for four years. When police finally arrived, bodycam footage captured her chilling confession and revealed what had happened to her parents, John and Lois.
